"""Mechanische Dokument-, Quellen-, Pointer- und Hashbindung; kein Produktimport.

finalize erzeugt ausschliesslich den eigenen neuen handoff.json und ergaenzt
sources.json. readback ist read-only. Keine Testdaten/Oracles werden ausgefuehrt.
"""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import source_mechanics as sm

ROOT = sm.ROOT
M = Path("F:/ChnobelRuntime/specification/v2-manifest-draft-01")
E = Path("F:/ChnobelRuntime/specification/v2-field-supplement-02/event-normalform")
REPO = Path("F:/Projects/Chnobel")
CHECKPOINT = "789e5c0e0d06f1d44313dddf1be343c2807e200d"
OWN = ["report.md", "digest-targets.json", "sources.json", "source_mechanics.py", "check_documents.py"]
POINTERS = ["/properties/candidate/properties/contentDigest", "/properties/candidate/properties/ruleDigest"]


def data(p):
    return json.loads(Path(p).read_bytes())


def at(obj, pointer):
    if pointer == "":
        return obj
    assert pointer.startswith("/")
    for part in pointer[1:].split("/"):
        key = part.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
        obj = obj[int(key)] if isinstance(obj, list) else obj[key]
    return obj


def blob(p):
    raw = Path(p).read_bytes()
    return {"path": Path(p).as_posix(), "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": sm.sha(raw)}


def git(*args):
    env = dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0")
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(REPO), *args], env=env)


def own_document_checks():
    d = data(ROOT / "digest-targets.json")
    assert d["scopeStatus"] == "COMPLETE"
    assert d["specificationStatus"] == "PROPOSED_NOT_ACCEPTED"
    assert d["implementationAuthorized"] is False
    assert d["blockerClosed"] is False
    assert d["wholeManifestVerdict"] == "NOT_ISSUED"
    assert [x["pointer"] for x in d["fields"]] == POINTERS
    assert len(d["threeControlRequirements"]) == 3
    assert all(x["execution"] == "NOT_RUN" for x in d["threeControlRequirements"])
    records = []
    for field in d["fields"]:
        for q in field["historicalEvidence"]:
            b = blob(q["path"])
            assert b["sha256"] == q["sha256"], q["path"]
            assert at(data(q["path"]), q["jsonPointer"]) == q["quotedValue"], q
            records.append({"path": q["path"], "jsonPointer": q["jsonPointer"], "sourceDigestMatched": True, "quotedValueMatched": True})
        t = field["proposedTarget"]
        b = blob(Path(t["referenceRoot"]) / t["relativePath"])
        assert b["bytes"] == t["observedReferenceBytes"]["bytes"]
        assert b["sha256"] == t["observedReferenceBytes"]["sha256"]
        assert field["historicalTargetProven"] is False
    for q in d["streamAndReplayBinding"]["existingDraftRules"]:
        assert blob(q["path"])["sha256"] == q["sha256"]
        lines = Path(q["path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        text = "\n".join(lines[q["lines"][0]-1:q["lines"][1]])
        assert q["quotedText"] in text
    ids = [x["id"] for x in d["impactedDeclarationRegister"]]
    assert len(ids) == len(set(ids))
    for field in d["fields"]:
        assert set(field["impactedDeclarations"]) <= set(ids)
    selected_sources = {x["path"] for x in sm.load()["immutableSources"]}
    for x in d["impactedDeclarationRegister"]:
        p = Path(d["sourceRoots"][x["root"]]) / x["path"]
        assert p.as_posix() in selected_sources
        for loc in x["locations"]:
            if loc.startswith("/"):
                at(data(p), loc)
    historical = data(M / "history/contracts/v1/ereignis.schema.json")["properties"]["candidate"]
    assert historical["additionalProperties"] is False
    assert set(historical["properties"]) == {"build", "content", "rules"}
    assert data(M / "manifest.json")["status"] == "INCOMPLETE"
    assert data(E / "field-normalform-event.json")["status"] == "INCOMPLETE"
    report = (ROOT / "report.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    words = len(report.split())
    assert words <= 1500, words
    assert "\u00df" not in report
    return {"fieldCount": len(d["fields"]), "declarativeControlCount": len(d["threeControlRequirements"]), "controlsExecuted": False, "reportWordCountWhitespaceSeparated": words, "quotedSources": records, "impactDeclarationCount": len(ids), "scopeGateFlagsMatched": True, "sourceStatusesStillIncomplete": True, "productResult": "NOT_ISSUED"}


def index_checks():
    s = sm.load()
    bindings = []
    docs = [(M / "manifest.json", "/components", data(M / "manifest.json")["components"]), (M / "handoff.json", "/files", data(M / "handoff.json")["files"]), (E / "handoff.json", "/files", data(E / "handoff.json")["files"])]
    for index_path, base, entries in docs:
        index_root = index_path.parent
        lookup = {x["path"]: (i, x) for i, x in enumerate(entries)}
        assert len(lookup) == len(entries)
        for src in s["immutableSources"]:
            p = Path(src["path"])
            if not p.is_relative_to(index_root):
                continue
            rel = p.relative_to(index_root).as_posix()
            if rel not in lookup:
                continue
            i, x = lookup[rel]
            assert x["sha256"] == src["sha256Before"]
            assert x["bytes"] == src["bytesBefore"]
            bindings.append({"index": index_path.as_posix(), "indexSha256": blob(index_path)["sha256"], "pointer": base+"/"+str(i), "target": p.as_posix(), "sha256": x["sha256"], "bytes": x["bytes"], "matched": True})
    for name in ("case-index.json", "case-index-base.json", "variant-index.json", "negative-case-index.json"):
        p = M / name
        for i, x in enumerate(data(p)):
            for key in ("input",):
                if key not in x:
                    continue
                ref = x[key]
                target = (M / ref["path"]).as_posix()
                src = next((y for y in s["immutableSources"] if y["path"] == target), None)
                if src is not None:
                    assert ref["sha256"] == src["sha256Before"] and ref["bytes"] == src["bytesBefore"]
                    bindings.append({"index": p.as_posix(), "indexSha256": blob(p)["sha256"], "pointer": "/"+str(i)+"/"+key, "target": target, "sha256": ref["sha256"], "bytes": ref["bytes"], "matched": True})
    return bindings


def historical_bindings():
    archive = data(M / "inventory/contract-byte-archive.json")
    selected = {x["path"] for x in sm.load()["immutableSources"]}
    result = []
    for i, x in enumerate(archive):
        p = M / x["file"]["path"]
        if p.as_posix() not in selected:
            continue
        raw = git("show", x["commit"]+":"+x["sourcePath"])
        assert raw == p.read_bytes()
        assert sm.sha(raw) == x["file"]["sha256"]
        result.append({"commit": x["commit"], "sourcePath": x["sourcePath"], "archivePointer": "/"+str(i)+"/file", "archive": x["file"], "gitSha256After": sm.sha(raw), "byteEqual": True})
    return result


def leaf_hash_references():
    catalogue = data(M / "catalogue.json")
    archive = data(M / "inventory/contract-byte-archive.json")
    lookup = {x["sourcePath"]: x for x in archive}
    result = []
    for i, rule in enumerate(catalogue["rules"]):
        ref = rule["targetProvenance"]
        x = lookup[ref["path"]]
        assert ref["commit"] == x["commit"]
        actual = blob(M / x["file"]["path"])
        assert ref["sha256"] == actual["sha256"]
        result.append({"sourcePointer": "/rules/"+str(i)+"/targetProvenance", "target": actual["path"], "sha256": actual["sha256"], "matched": True})
    # Lediglich String-/Referenzinventur der gelesenen Blaetter, keine Auswertung.
    occurrences = []
    def walk(x, ptr):
        if isinstance(x, str) and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", x):
            occurrences.append({"pointer": ptr, "sha256": x})
        elif isinstance(x, dict):
            for k, v in x.items():
                walk(v, ptr+"/"+k)
        elif isinstance(x, list):
            for i, v in enumerate(x):
                walk(v, ptr+"/"+str(i))
    for f in ["content.json", "catalogue.json", "rule-records.json"]:
        walk(data(M / f), f+"#")
    expected = [{"pointer": "catalogue.json#/rules/"+str(i)+"/targetProvenance/sha256", "sha256": x["sha256"]} for i, x in enumerate(result)]
    assert occurrences == expected
    return {"literalSha256ReferencesInSelectedLeaves": occurrences, "catalogueHistoricalTargets": result, "referenceMeaning": "Nur String-/Rohbyteabgleich; Pfadverweise werden nicht rekursiv gehasht. Kein fachliches Oracle- oder Kontrollfallresultat."}


def finalize():
    assert not (ROOT / "handoff.json").exists(), "Handoff existiert bereits"
    found = {p.name for p in ROOT.iterdir()}
    assert found == set(OWN) | {"brief.md"}, found
    doc_checks = own_document_checks()
    index = index_checks()
    historical = historical_bindings()
    leaf_refs = leaf_hash_references()
    s = sm.load()
    for row in s["authorityGitBindings"]:
        raw = git("show", row["commit"]+":"+row["path"])
        row["gitSha256After"] = sm.sha(raw)
        row["gitUnchanged"] = row["gitSha256After"] == row["gitSha256"]
        assert row["gitUnchanged"]
    s["historicalGitReadback"] = historical
    s["indexBindings"] = index
    s["documentChecks"] = doc_checks
    s["leafHashReferenceChecks"] = leaf_refs
    s["captureBoundary"] = "Rohhashes wurden vor der Bericht-/Normvorschlagserstellung erfasst und danach erneut gelesen. Pflichttexte waren teils schon vor der Inventur gelesen; keine Behauptung eines zeitlich frueheren Vollrepository-Snapshots."
    context_names = [str(Path(x["path"]).relative_to(REPO)).replace("\\", "/") for x in s["mutableContext"]]
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
    checkpoint_matches = []
    for x, name in zip(s["mutableContext"], context_names):
        b = git("show", CHECKPOINT+":"+name)
        checkpoint_matches.append({"path": x["path"], "checkpoint": CHECKPOINT, "checkpointSha256": sm.sha(b), "matchesBeforeRaw": sm.sha(b) == x["sha256Before"], "checkpointTextEqualsWorkingExceptCRLF": b.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n") == Path(x["path"]).read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")})
    s["parentContextObservation"] = {"briefCheckpoint": CHECKPOINT, "headAtFinalSourceRead": head, "files": checkpoint_matches, "committedContextDiff": git("diff", CHECKPOINT, head, "--", *context_names).decode("utf-8"), "workingContextDiff": git("diff", head, "--", *context_names).decode("utf-8"), "note": "Nur Elternkontext. Kein Normstatus, kein Git-Schreibzugriff; Archive/Queue nicht gelesen."}
    sm.save(s)
    sm.finish()
    s = sm.load()
    assert s["immutableUnchanged"]
    owned = []
    for name in OWN:
        b = blob(ROOT / name)
        owned.append({"path": name, "absolutePath": b["path"], "sha256": b["sha256"], "bytes": b["bytes"]})
    handoff = {
        "scopeStatus": "COMPLETE", "specificationStatus": "PROPOSED_NOT_ACCEPTED",
        "scope": POINTERS, "blockerId": "B-EVENT-DIGEST-TARGET", "blockerClosed": False,
        "implementationAuthorized": False, "wholeManifestVerdict": "NOT_ISSUED", "foreignReviewPerformed": False,
        "outputRoot": ROOT.as_posix(), "files": owned, "ownedFileCountExcludingSelf": len(owned),
        "brief": blob(ROOT / "brief.md"), "briefRole": "INPUT_NOT_OWNED_OUTPUT",
        "immutableSources": [{"path": x["path"], "sha256Before": x["sha256Before"], "sha256After": x["sha256After"], "bytes": x["bytesAfter"], "unchanged": x["unchanged"]} for x in s["immutableSources"]],
        "mutableContext": s["mutableContext"], "immutableSourceCount": len(s["immutableSources"]),
        "immutableUnchanged": s["immutableUnchanged"], "contextChangedPaths": s["contextChangedPaths"],
        "mechanicalResult": doc_checks, "indexBindingCount": len(index),
        "selfHashPolicy": "Alle eigenen Dateien ausser sich selbst gebunden. Kein Selbstdigest und keine Signatur; Handoffhash separat in der Rueckmeldung.",
        "productExecution": "NOT_RUN", "schemaValidation": "NOT_RUN", "evaluatorExecution": "NOT_RUN", "testExecution": "NOT_RUN",
        "sourceWrites": False, "repositoryWrites": False, "gitWrites": False, "cronChanges": False,
        "childrenStarted": 0, "portalCiSecretSigningUploadActions": 0,
        "nextGate": "Fremde Pruefung und ausdrueckliche Annahme des technischen Vorschlags; erforderlichenfalls gesonderte Entscheidung. Danach neue vollstaendige Manifestfassung mit Freeze und Fremdpruefung. Keine eigene Blockerschliessung oder Implementation.",
        "authorStoppedAfterDelivery": True
    }
    with (ROOT / "handoff.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as out:
        json.dump(handoff, out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        out.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({"finalized": True, "mechanicalDocumentChecks": doc_checks, "sourceCount": len(s["immutableSources"]), "indexBindingCount": len(index), "handoff": blob(ROOT / "handoff.json")}, ensure_ascii=False))


def readback():
    h = data(ROOT / "handoff.json")
    assert {x["path"] for x in h["files"]} == set(OWN)
    assert {x.name for x in ROOT.iterdir()} == set(OWN) | {"brief.md", "handoff.json"}
    for x in h["files"]:
        b = blob(ROOT / x["path"])
        assert b["sha256"] == x["sha256"] and b["bytes"] == x["bytes"]
    for x in h["immutableSources"]:
        b = blob(x["path"])
        assert x["sha256Before"] == x["sha256After"] == b["sha256"]
        assert b["bytes"] == x["bytes"]
    assert own_document_checks() == h["mechanicalResult"]
    assert index_checks() == data(ROOT / "sources.json")["indexBindings"]
    changed_since_capture = [x["path"] for x in h["mutableContext"] if blob(x["path"])["sha256"] != x["sha256After"]]
    print(json.dumps({"readback": "MECHANICAL_DOCUMENT_BINDINGS_MATCH", "ownedFilesExcludingHandoff": len(h["files"]), "immutableSources": len(h["immutableSources"]), "immutableUnchanged": True, "mutableContextChangedSinceFinalCapture": changed_since_capture, "fields": len(h["scope"]), "declarativeControls": h["mechanicalResult"]["declarativeControlCount"], "controlsExecuted": False, "reportWords": h["mechanicalResult"]["reportWordCountWhitespaceSeparated"], "specificationStatus": h["specificationStatus"], "blockerClosed": False, "implementationAuthorized": False, "handoff": blob(ROOT / "handoff.json")}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert sys.dont_write_bytecode
    assert all(os.environ.get(k, "").replace("\\", "/").startswith("F:/ChnobelRuntime/") for k in ("TEMP", "TMP", "TMPDIR"))
    {"finalize": finalize, "readback": readback}[sys.argv[1]]()
